title: A single-point square-zero obstruction to versality
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: A failure of formal versality is converted into an actual square-zero thickening of an affine neighbourhood by pushing out a small Artinian extension. The proof then shows that any local retraction would factor through a finite infinitesimal neighbourhood and contradict the selected lifting obstruction.
